title: Tanks above the lowest floor.
officialText:
For tanks installed inside of buildings above the lowest floor, the combination normal and
emergency vent piping shall be piped, in an approved manner, into the vent or top of tank of the lowest floor storage tank that supplies
the fuel to such tank. Normal and emergency vents are to be sized in accordance with NFPA 30.
